description: The bar chart illustrates the "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Different AI Models," and displays three models in the following order: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. The chart uses grouped vertical bars, with each AI model category containing a cluster of three bars representing different sycophancy reduction methods, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. These methods are visually arranged from left to right within each group as "Baseline" (muted reddish-brown), "Source Info" (muted olive), and "Direct Command" (muted blue-grey). Across all three models, the "Source Info" bars consistently display the highest values within their respective groups, while the "Baseline" bars display the lowest. The tallest bar overall is the "Source Info" method for GPT-4, reaching an approximate value of 5.22, while the shortest bar overall is the "Baseline" method for Llama, with an approximate value of 4.55. Other approximate values include GPT-4 Baseline at 4.88 and Direct Command at 5.05; Claude Baseline at 4.68, Source Info at 5.12, and Direct Command at 4.93; and Llama Source Info at 4.95 and Direct Command at 4.81. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow a strict alphabetical or value-based sort, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines or annotations, though the entire chart is rendered with a dark, low-contrast grey overlay.
